Ah, Arma III. Heard many great things about it. I thought that being any good at Battlefield multiplayer was a feat. But this game takes things to a whole new level. The singleplayer campaign itself (as of writing this review) is very nice, has a good storyline to it (I actually haven't even completed it yet but as of now it has been very captivating). It is the most realistic and immersive military simulation I have ever seen, and I would highly reccomend it for anywho who enjoys military operations. It takes you beyond the scripted CoD style gameplay and makes things feel much more immersive. And this is just the singleplayer. You can also play online, and there are tons of different servers and game modes available, including a role-playing gamemode (such as Altis Life) which changes the experience entirely. STEAM Workshop adds multiple great things that you can use in Arma III, and you can also create your own missions. Also, if you are not a fan of first-person shooters... there is a 3rd person camera ;) Overall, this is probably the most addicting game I have ever played that involves some sort of combat. Definitely a must buy if you have the spare money. The user interface and controls take a while to get used to at first but it is well worth the time and effort. Get ready to spend some time hoofing it on the battlefield and running for cover; this game truly makes things come to life!

10/10 Should buy.

*NOTE* Yes there are some minor problems you may experience every once in a while, such as if you drive a truck over a bush your tire may pop, or if you run into a fence, your vehicle may explode. But to be completely honest, I think that the pros greatly outweigh the cons and I would think that most anyone who has played Arma III would say that, while it can be frustrating at times, it is really quite fun and a great experience.
